standard.summary: 把 UNet attention 计算按 head/batch 切成小片顺序执行，降低注意力矩阵的峰值显存。默认开启。
standard.effect: 模型准备阶段对 UNet 调用 enable_attention_slicing('auto')；每次只算一部分 attention head，峰值激活显存下降，速度略微变慢。
standard.whenToUse: 显存吃紧的 SD/SDXL 训练（低显存 profile 会强制开启）；高分辨率或大 batch 下 attention 矩阵成为显存峰值来源时。
standard.avoidWhen: 已使用 xformers/FlashAttention/SDPA 等内存高效 attention 后端时收益重复且可能互斥——现代后端本身就不物化完整注意力矩阵；追求极限吞吐且显存富余时可关闭。

standard_en.summary: Slices UNet attention by head/batch and runs the pieces in sequence, lowering the peak memory of the attention matrix. On by default.
standard_en.effect: During model preparation the UNet gets enable_attention_slicing('auto'); each pass computes only some of the attention heads, so peak activation memory drops and speed falls slightly.
standard_en.whenToUse: SD/SDXL runs where VRAM is tight (the low-VRAM profile forces it on), and any case where the attention matrix at high resolution or large batch is what sets the memory peak.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When a memory-efficient attention backend such as xformers, FlashAttention or SDPA is already in use, the benefit is redundant and may conflict -- modern backends never materialise the full attention matrix. Turn it off when chasing maximum throughput with VRAM to spare.

advanced.principle: 朴素 attention 需要物化 [batch×heads, seq, seq] 的注意力得分矩阵；按 head 维切片后每次只保留 1/N 的矩阵，峰值显存近似降为 1/N，代价是 kernel 串行化带来的时间开销。
advanced.intervention: trainer_prepare_mixin.py 构造显存 slicer 时读取（与 vae_slicing/vae_tiling 并列），memory_optimization_formats.py 对 pipeline 或裸 UNet 调用 enable_attention_slicing('auto')；低显存 profile（sdxl_lora_low_vram_profile.py、trainer_model_prep_runtime_profiles.py）会强制置 True；显存预估器（training_advisor_vram.py）对开启状态按 ×0.92 折算激活显存。
advanced.expectedImpact: 峰值显存降低约 5%~15%（取决于分辨率与 batch），吞吐轻微下降。
advanced.tradeoffs: 对 DiT 族（Anima 等）此路径不适用（原生 UNet stub 为 no-op）；与 attention 后端选择（attention_backend）解耦，两者的显存收益不叠加。

advanced_en.principle: Naive attention must materialize the [batch×heads, seq, seq] score matrix; slicing along the head dimension keeps only 1/N of the matrix at a time, dropping peak VRAM roughly to 1/N at the cost of kernel serialization overhead.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer_prepare_mixin.py reads it when constructing the VRAM slicer (alongside vae_slicing/vae_tiling); memory_optimization_formats.py calls enable_attention_slicing('auto') on the pipeline or bare UNet; low-VRAM profiles (sdxl_lora_low_vram_profile.py, trainer_model_prep_runtime_profiles.py) force it True; the VRAM estimator (training_advisor_vram.py) scales activation VRAM by ×0.92 when it is on.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Peak VRAM drops roughly 5%~15% (resolution- and batch-dependent) with a slight throughput decrease.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Not applicable to the DiT family (Anima etc.) — the native UNet stub is a no-op there; decoupled from attention-backend choice (attention_backend), and their VRAM savings do not stack.
